mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a quarter indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are adversely impacted.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production boosts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances when CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a month signals a strengthening demand for housing, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing sector and related industries benefit.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% each within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% each in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% each within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are positively impacted.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters.
